label: L-05
title: Constructor _owner shadowing across three contracts — local parameter hides inherited Ownable._owner state variable
description: All three constructors declare a local parameter named `_owner` which shadows the inherited Ownable._owner state variable. Benign here because the constructors immediately pass `_owner` to the Ownable initializer. If any future constructor logic reads `_owner` expecting the state variable, it would silently read the parameter.
impact: No current security impact. Code quality finding to prevent future confusion.
attackPath: Future constructor logic that reads _owner expecting the state variable would silently read the parameter instead
